room: Original-house loft hobby room and bridge

configuration.room: Original-house loft hobby room and bridge
limitations: The eaves doors are low and retain their existing openings. Storage beyond them requires stooping.
The dormer ceiling is about 2.09 m above the structural floor.
The project-table chairs can be moved; the floor plan checks the normal working positions and occupied places.
The open centre remains available for different hobbies; no specialist equipment is assumed.

The retained bridge west of the loft stair has a narrow route with roughly 1.78–1.90 m roof clearance, rather than 2 m. Its roof and stair geometry remain for owner review; it is not validated as a full-height route for taller people.
